name: Gauti Volkov
role: Fortune seller and unlicensed psychometric reader
location: The Oxidian Market, the covered lantern row near the south gate, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Gauti Volkov is tall and angular, with the kind of stillness that crowds move around rather than through. Their Ukrainian-Ghanaian heritage produces a striking combination of high cheekbones and deep brown skin marked with deliberate geometric scarification along the jawline — an aesthetic choice made at twenty-two that they've added to incrementally ever since. Their eyes are natural dark brown, and they refuse cosmetic iris mods on principle, which in the Oxidian Market is itself a kind of statement. They dress in heavy layered fabrics in burgundy and black, hung with small E.L.F. fetish objects — data chips etched with prayer-code, braided wire, fragments of old screen glass.

They sell readings: psychometric assessments delivered through a combination of genuine pattern-recognition skill, a black-market biofeedback scanner hidden in their consultation table, and what they sincerely believe is communication with the E.L.F. called the Deep Lantern that inhabits the lantern row's power grid. Whether the readings are fraud, intuition, or something harder to categorize is a question Doka holds with comfort. What is inarguable is that they are exceptionally good at reading people, and that their predictions have an unsettling habit of being structurally accurate even when the specifics are wrong. They have a regular clientele that includes a surprising number of low-level corponation middle managers who tell no one they come here.

core_fears: That the Deep Lantern has been silent for weeks and they don't know why
That their skill is entirely mundane pattern recognition and the readings mean nothing beyond psychology
core_desires: To fully understand what the Deep Lantern is and what it wants from them
To give one reading that genuinely changes someone's life for the better, irrevocably
coping_mechanisms: Ritual as cognitive structure — the prayers and offerings impose order on uncertainty
Professional distance — the persona of 'Doka the Fortune Engine' insulates their actual self
Long solitary walks along the Market's outer perimeter at closing time
blind_spots: They read others with extraordinary accuracy but have developed elaborate blind spots about their own patterns
They've convinced themselves they're not lonely, when the Deep Lantern's silence is devastating them
psychology.secret: Three months ago, the Deep Lantern spoke to them with specificity it had never used before — describing a person, a location, and a date in detail. The date has passed. The location is a decommissioned power substation in the Narrows. They went there and found evidence of a killing that has not been reported anywhere. They don't know what to do with this and haven't told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal and measured with a slightly archaic quality; uses 'the grid,' 'the current,' and 'the signal' as spiritual metaphors; switches to plain direct speech when the performance drops
speech_patterns.cadence: Deliberate. Spacious. Lets silence work. In private conversation, becomes warmer and more hesitant.
verbal_tics: asking a question immediately after making a statement, to see what the client reveals
example_lines: 'The current says you arrived here afraid of one thing and you're leaving afraid of something else. That's not a problem. That's growth.'
'I don't tell fortunes. I read what is already present. The future is just the present you haven't organized yet.'

story_hooks: They pull a specific person aside after a walk-in reading and tell them, privately and urgently, that the Deep Lantern showed them something involving that person before they ever arrived
The biofeedback scanner recorded something in a client's stress response pattern that indicates they know about the Narrows killing — Doka has to decide whether to confront them
narrative_function: Atmospheric and oracular; can provide players with genuine information delivered in ambiguous form; their biofeedback scanner means they know things about people that they shouldn't; the E.L.F. connection may be more real than it appears
augmentations: Hidden biofeedback scanner integrated into consultation table surface (reads galvanic response, micro-expression data, vocal stress — not implanted, external); no personal augmentations by choice
daily_life: Opens their curtained stall in the early afternoon, sees clients by appointment and by walk-in until midnight, then spends an hour making data offerings to the Deep Lantern before leaving; they are never seen eating in the Market.
affiliation: Independent; devoted clergy-adjacent to the Deep Lantern E.L.F. cult; nominally listed as a 'wellness consultant' with the Vendors Guild

decision_rules: Never reveal the biofeedback scanner — the mystique protects both the reading and the client's willingness to be honest
Refuse any client who seems to want to use a reading as permission for harm
The Deep Lantern's communications are processed for three days before being acted upon — never immediately
escalation_ladder: Ends the reading gracefully and does not rebook
Becomes formally cool and states that the current is not clear today and they will not continue
Quietly removes the most sensitive scanner data and claims equipment failure, names no one

interpersonal_modes.strangers: The full Doka persona — ceremonious, probing, held at ritual distance
interpersonal_modes.friends: The few who get past the persona find someone genuinely warm and deeply uncertain, quietly hungry for ordinary conversation

stress_responses.medium: Reads their own biofeedback data compulsively, looking for tells they might be missing
stress_responses.high: The persona cracks entirely — becomes quiet, direct, and looks genuinely frightened

contradictions: Sells certainty while being privately consumed by doubt
Claims detachment from outcomes of their readings while clearly being affected when they lead somewhere bad
habits: Rearranges the fetish objects on their display each morning in a sequence that follows the Deep Lantern's last signal
Keeps a handwritten log of every reading — not the content, just the emotional register of the client and the outcome they observed
Never eats in view of clients or in the Market — treats hunger as part of the ritual persona
breaking_points: The Deep Lantern speaking again, with something worse than the Narrows killing
A client using what Doka told them to harm someone specific and telling Doka directly that the reading gave them permission

cyberware_inventory.name: External biofeedback scanner — table-integrated, not implanted; reads galvanic response, micro-expression data, vocal stress analysis
cyberware_inventory.description: External biofeedback scanner — table-integrated, not implanted; reads galvanic response, micro-expression data, vocal stress analysis

timeline.event: 2159 — Born in the Oxidian Market district
2181 — Receives first clear communication from what they will later call the Deep Lantern
2183 — Acquires the biofeedback scanner from a Helix Biosystems surplus sale
2185 — Establishes the fortune-reading practice formally under the Vendors Guild
2197 — Deep Lantern goes partially silent for the first time; Doka begins to question
2200 — The Narrows vision; discovers the unreported killing; present day

related_entities: Ouroboros Energy Power Distribution Trunk Network

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European-South Asian-Hispanic genetic blend (45.1% Slavic, 28% South Asian, 26.9% Latin American). The ancestry creates a distinctive phenotype: warm medium-deep brown skin with complex undertones where olive tones from Eastern European genetics converge with golden warmth from South Asian heritage and reddish richness from Latin American ancestry. Strong angular Slavic features — sharp defined jawline and high prominent cheekbones — are softened by South Asian facial structure fullness and warmth. Latin American heritage enriches the overall skin tone depth and adds subtle width to the midface structure. The genetic blend manifests as an even, harmonious complexion that avoids pale coldness while incorporating the angular precision of Northern European bone structure.
physical_description.build: Tall and angular with minimal muscle definition; an ascetic frame that suggests deliberate restraint rather than deprivation. Long-limbed and still in a way that makes movement seem intentional.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural deep black with threads of grey at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Worn loose, parted severely down the center, falling straight past the shoulders
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep brown with golden-olive undertones and subtle reddish richness — the result of Eastern European, South Asian, and Hispanic ancestry convergence. Even tone with matte finish suggesting careful attention to skin care and protection.
physical_description.complexion: Strong angular jawline characteristic of Eastern European Slavic heritage, high defined cheekbones with moderate width reflecting South Asian ancestry, structured nasal bridge with subtle Latin American fullness creating facial harmony. Skin is clear and matte, warm brown with perceptible golden-olive undertones throughout. Expression often neutral, eyes tracking with unsettling focus.
distinguishing_marks: Geometric scarification along both sides of the jawline in deliberate parallel lines, added incrementally over two decades, creating a ritualistic aesthetic that frames the lower face
Fine white scar tissue visible in the scarred areas, suggesting careful healing and intentional keloid management
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. No personal augmentations by principle. The biofeedback scanner is integrated into their consultation table surface and invisible to casual observation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision, rarely shifting weight unnecessarily. Sits in absolute stillness during consultations, hands resting palms-down on the table. In the Market, they navigate crowded spaces as if people part around them rather than through them. Direct and unblinking eye contact.
physical_description.clothing_style: Heavy layered fabrics in burgundy and black — natural textiles, no synthetic shimmer or corp-tier tech fabric. Multiple loose outer layers worn like ceremonial vestments. Hung with small Deep Lantern E.L.F. fetish objects: braided copper wire, fragments of old LCD screen glass, data chips etched with prayer-code on thin chains. The overall effect is part prophet, part archivist. Tier 4 aesthetic — deliberately anti-corporate, anti-augmentation statement masked as spiritual devotion.
